title: Reefer Cargo Services: which bookings, equipment, trade lanes and commodities a tier accepts
content:
## Scope

This clause of **Reefer Cargo Services** sets the admission conditions that the booking and the cargo must meet before a reefer service of a given tier is ordered for a container.

## Rule

1. A reefer service is ordered only for a booking whose cargo type is reefer and whose booking status is requested or confirmed. Both facts are read from the company's booking record for the booking named in the order, not from the customer's description.
2. The booking's equipment type must be one of the tier's allowed equipment types.
3. The booking's trade lane must be one of the tier's allowed trade lanes.
4. The commodity must be one of the tier's eligible commodities, unless the tier's list is "all", which means any temperature-controlled cargo.

## Admission table by tier

| Tier | Equipment types | Trade lanes | Eligible commodities |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Reefer Standard | 20RF, 40RH | All eight lanes listed below | All (any temperature-controlled cargo) |
| AHL Reefer Monitored | 20RF, 40RH | All eight lanes listed below | All (any temperature-controlled cargo) |
| AHL Reefer Cold Treatment | 20RF, 40RH | Transpacific Eastbound; Asia-US East Coast; Asia-North Europe; Europe-South America East Coast; Intra-Asia | Fresh citrus, fresh table grapes, fresh apples, fresh pears, fresh kiwifruit, fresh blueberries |
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | 40RH only | Europe-South America East Coast; Asia-North Europe; Asia-Mediterranean; Transpacific Eastbound | Fresh avocados, fresh bananas, fresh berries, fresh stone fruit, fresh cut flowers |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP | 20RF, 40RH | All eight lanes listed below | Pharmaceuticals, clinical trial supplies, vaccines |
| AHL Reefer Superfreezer | 40RH only | Asia-North Europe; Intra-Asia; Transpacific Eastbound | Frozen tuna, frozen seafood, frozen biological samples |

The eight lanes on which AHL Reefer Standard, AHL Reefer Monitored and AHL Reefer Pharma GDP are offered: Asia-North Europe, Asia-Mediterranean, Transpacific Eastbound, Asia-US East Coast, Transatlantic Westbound, Intra-Asia, Asia-Middle East and India, Europe-South America East Coast.

## Admission checklist

| Check | Source of the fact | Passes when |
|---|---|---|
| Cargo type | Booking record | Reefer |
| Booking status | Booking record | Requested or confirmed |
| Equipment type | Booking record | Listed for the tier |
| Trade lane | Booking record | Listed for the tier |
| Commodity | The order | Listed for the tier, or the tier accepts all |

Each check must pass; this clause does not accept an order that fails any one of them.

## Hypothetical points of judgement

> **Commodity and lane both fit, equipment does not.** A booking on Asia-North Europe with 20RF equipment asks for AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere for fresh avocados. The tier uses 40RH only, so the order does not meet this clause.

> **Commodity outside a closed list.** Fresh mangoes are requested under AHL Reefer Cold Treatment. The tier's commodity list is closed and does not include them, so the order does not meet this clause; under AHL Reefer Standard, whose list is "all", the commodity condition is met.

> **Lane outside the tier.** Frozen seafood on Transatlantic Westbound under AHL Reefer Superfreezer: the lane is not among that tier's three lanes, so the order does not meet this clause.

> **Booking in any other status.** A booking whose status is neither requested nor confirmed cannot take a new reefer service, whatever the tier.

**Is a booking whose cargo type is not reefer acceptable because it uses a 40RH container?** No. The booking's cargo type must be reefer; the equipment type alone does not satisfy the first condition.
